directives.directive: This revision MUST NOT add judgment-recording, approval-waiting, or human-confirmation procedures; it defines only what the norm closes and what implementation judgment decides.

A rule change MUST align the rule body, shared API, registry, applicable profile, and conformance expectations in the same revision. A new rule ID MUST be assigned only to an obligation that existing IDs cannot express as a specialization.

completion_criteria.criterion: For the same input and the same declared profile, two conforming implementations MUST NOT disagree on authorization, retry, commit, or client compatibility. Storage, internal structure, execution method, optimization, and profile-declared choices MAY differ.
